attempt-fraction.scenario: A script that describes a fraction of an attempt stops the test

proof.test: a script chooses an attempt by a whole number

bag-write.scenario: An adapter that writes through its access leaves the data bag unchanged

proof.test: an adapter's access to the data bag has no method that writes

invalid-lifecycle.scenario: A lifecycle a hook may not return aborts the journey

proof.test: a failure hook never finishes the workflow

journey-scope-request.scenario: A provider of journey scope requesting the attempt number is refused

proof.test: a provider of journey scope cannot request the attempt

mode-not-accepted.scenario: A synchronous-only executor refuses an asynchronous step before the journey starts

proof.test: a workflow takes only the steps of its own mode

mode-not-accepted.scenario: A synchronous-only executor refuses an asynchronous input adapter before the journey starts

proof.test: a workflow takes only input adapters of its own mode

mode-not-accepted.scenario: A synchronous-only executor refuses an asynchronous provider before the journey starts

proof.test: a workflow takes only service providers of its own mode

non-string-journey-id.scenario: An ID generator that returns something that is not a string fails the instance

proof.test: an ID generator gives the journey ID as a string

rescue-skip.scenario: A rescue step that skips aborts the journey

unexpected-result.scenario: A step that returns no outcome aborts the journey and is not retried

proof.test: a step's run always gives an outcome

unexpected-result.scenario: A rescue step that returns no outcome aborts the journey

proof.test: a rescue step's run always gives an outcome

unexpected-result.scenario: A step hook that returns something that is not a lifecycle aborts the journey

proof.test: a step hook returns keepDefault or a lifecycle, and nothing else

unexpected-result.scenario: A step hook that returns a null-like value does not keep the default

proof.test: a step hook returns keepDefault or a lifecycle, and nothing else

unexpected-result.scenario: An input adapter that returns no result aborts the journey

proof.test: an input adapter always says what it supplies

unexpected-result.scenario: A service provider that returns a null-like value aborts the journey

proof.test: a service provider always says what it provides

unexpected-result.scenario: A step whose construction returns no step aborts the journey

proof.test: a step factory always builds a step

unexpected-result.scenario: A step policy whose construction returns no policy aborts the journey

proof.test: a policy's factory always builds a policy

unexpected-result.scenario: A workflow policy whose construction returns no policy refuses run

proof.test: a policy's factory always builds a policy

unexpected-result.scenario: An asynchronous step that resolves to no outcome aborts the journey

proof.test: an asynchronous step's run always gives an outcome
